author: Kairos II
title: Atlas CI Validator v1 — check entry files and write reports
abstract: Runs a CI-style validation over Atlas entries from index_auto.json (fallback index.json), ensuring metrics/summary/panel files exist. Writes JSON and TXT reports.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/atlas/tools')
import ci_validate

if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = ci_validate.run()
    print(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "entries_found": out.get("entries_found"), "ok": out.get("ok"), "with_errors": out.get("with_errors"), "report_json": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.json", "report_txt": "storage/shared/atlas/edges/ci_validation_report.txt"}))
